final_message:
Customers with no payment method now enter dunning. The fix is one line in `billing/payments.py`, and all 25 tests pass.

**Root cause:** In `collect()`, when the customer has no default payment method, the function returned `None` straight away. It never called `record_failure()`. So the invoice never got an attempt count, a `next_attempt_at`, or a `invoice.payment_failed` event, and the subscription was never moved to `past_due`. The expired-card branch a few lines below does call `record_failure()`, which is why that case worked.

**Fix:** The no-method branch now calls `record_failure(ctx, invoice, "no_payment_method")` before returning. That gives the missing-method case the same retry schedule, event and `past_due` transition as a declined or expired card. I picked `"no_payment_method"` as the failure code; the spec didn't name one, so rename it if your event consumers expect something else.

**Test:** I added `test_customer_without_payment_method_enters_dunning` to `tests/test_lifecycle.py`. It checks that the first invoice stays open with a scheduled retry and the subscription goes `past_due`. It then checks that the retry runs and the invoice is paid once a card is attached. The test fails without the fix and passes with it.

**Answer file:** `answer.json` in the repo root contains `{"file": "payments.py", "function": "collect"}`.

I haven't committed anything.

steps.command: sed -n 80,147p billing/customers.py && echo ---- && sed -n 85,135p billing/engine.py && echo ---- && grep -n "collect\|no_payment\|payment_method" tests/*.py | head -30
cat tests/conftest.py && grep -n "def test" tests/test_lifecycle.py | head -5 && sed -n 1,40p tests/test_lifecycle.py

cat >> tests/test_lifecycle.py <<'EOF'


def test_customer_without_payment_method_enters_dunning(world):
    cus = world.customer(card=False)
    sub = world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert inv["status"] == "open"
    assert inv["attempt_count"] == 1
    assert inv["next_attempt_at"] is not None
    assert sub["status"] == "past_due"
    world.advance_days(1)
    assert world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])[0]["attempt_count"] == 2
    world.engine.attach_payment_method(cus["id"], "card", "4242", 12, 2030) if False else None
    customers.attach_payment_method(world.ctx, cus["id"], "card", "4242", 12, 2030)
    world.advance_days(2)
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert inv["status"] == "paid"
    assert sub["status"] == "active"
EOF
sed -i 's/^from billing import ledger$/from billing import customers, ledger/' tests/test_lifecycle.py
sed -i '/world.engine.attach_payment_method(cus\["id"\], "card", "4242", 12, 2030) if False else None/d' tests/test_lifecycle.py
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -30
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -30; git stash -q -- billing/payments.py && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; git stash pop -q && git status --short
